cohort: The study included 1953 pregnant women who delivered at Prof. Dr. R. D. Kandou General Hospital Manado between January 2021 and December 2022.
finding: Anemia in pregnancy was significantly associated with an increased rate of caesarean section, premature delivery, low birth weight, low APGAR score, and fetal death, but not with preeclampsia, prolonged labor, maternal mortality, or IUGR.
mod_finding: Anemia in pregnancy was significantly associated with an increased rate of caesarean section.
